description:
Open the T8 housing bracket CAD model in FreeCAD, measure its key geometric properties, and save a structured measurement report. 

The model is located at '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/T8_housing_bracket.FCStd'.

You must determine the following properties for the main solid body:
1. Bounding Box dimensions (X, Y, Z lengths) in mm
2. Total Volume in mm³
3. Total Surface Area in mm²
4. Center of Mass coordinates (X, Y, Z) in mm

Create a report file at '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/measurement_report.txt' with the following exact format:
BoundingBox_X: <value>
BoundingBox_Y: <value>
BoundingBox_Z: <value>
Volume: <value>
SurfaceArea: <value>
CenterOfMass_X: <value>
CenterOfMass_Y: <value>
CenterOfMass_Z: <value>

Values should be plain numbers rounded to 2 decimal places.
